description: This file defines a NetworkStatusService class for checking network connectivity status asynchronously using NWPathMonitor, along with internal state management and payload creation logic.

classes.name: NetworkStatusService
classes.description: A service class that asynchronously retrieves current network status, utilizing NWPathMonitor, with fallback in case of timeout.

classes.name: NetworkStatusState
classes.description: A private class managing completion state with thread safety for network status checks.

methods.name: currentStatus(timeoutMs: Int = 1500) async -> OpenClawNetworkStatusPayload
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves current network status with a timeout, utilizing NWPathMonitor and continuation.

methods.name: payload(from path: NWPath) -> OpenClawNetworkStatusPayload
methods.description: Creates a payload object representing network status based on NWPath properties.

methods.name: fallbackPayload() -> OpenClawNetworkStatusPayload
methods.description: Provides a default payload indicating no network connectivity.

methods.name: markCompleted() -> Bool
methods.description: Sets the internal completed flag to true if not already set, returning true if it was set by this call.
